query: Which simulation parameters (lesion size/contrast/location, bias field magnitude, motion, SNR) most influence leakage and detection, and what ablation sequence and metrics (AUC, sim‑to‑real gap) will quantify their effects?

response.query: Which simulation parameters (lesion size/contrast/location, bias field magnitude, motion, SNR) most influence leakage and detection, and what ablation sequence and metrics (AUC, sim‑to‑real gap) will quantify their effects?
response.answer: Lesion size, contrast, and location, along with bias field magnitude and motion, most influence leakage and detection. AUC and sim-to-real gap metrics quantify their effects.
